# Build iOS

**An APK does not run on iPhone.** iOS needs an iOS build signed through Apple's program, built with Xcode on macOS.

## Status
`app/ios` is a generated, synced Capacitor iOS project (bundle id `com.smartmanager.loyalty`). **No iOS binary was built or tested** — the authoring environment has no macOS/Xcode.

## Steps (macOS, Xcode 16+, CocoaPods or SPM as generated by Capacitor 8)
```bash
npm install
npm run build -w app
cd app && npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```
In Xcode: select the *App* target → Signing & Capabilities → your Team and a unique bundle ID → run on a device (Product → Run) or Archive → Distribute (TestFlight/App Store/Ad Hoc). Put your public key in `app/trusted-keys.json` before building.

## Platform notes
* Device identity is stored in the **Keychain** (`capacitor-secure-storage-plugin`), which normally survives app reinstall; restoring an iCloud/iTunes backup to a *new* device does not transfer Keychain items protected "this device only", so a new device code → reissue.
* Files: backups/exports go through the system share sheet (Files, iCloud Drive, AirDrop). Importing uses the document picker.
* Exclude the SQLite file from iCloud backup if you want no cloud copy (set the "do not back up" attribute for the Library/CapacitorDatabase folder in `AppDelegate`); document your choice for customers.
* RTL: set the app language to Arabic inside the app; layout mirrors via `dir="rtl"`.
* Offline test: enable Airplane Mode and repeat the checklist in BUILD_ANDROID.md.
